title: preferences.json — Clarify phase output
description: The resolved migration preferences produced by the clarify phase and consumed by design/estimate/plan/generate. FLOOR contract (required structure only; additional properties allowed). IMPORTANT: only the CHECKABLE part of clarify's contract lives here — the envelope, the uniform {value, chosen_by, source?} constraint-entry shape, and the closed enums. The CONDITIONAL and PROVENANCE rules (only write a key if it produces a constraint; source-prefix correctness; ai_constraints present iff Category F fired; the interview Validation Checklist) are JUDGMENT and remain prose in clarify-assemble.md — a schema cannot express them. design_constraints/ai_constraints hold zero-or-more constraint entries; absent keys mean 'no constraint — Design decides'. ai_constraints is OPTIONAL (present only when Category F / AI artifacts fired).

constraintEntry.description: A single resolved constraint. Uniform shape across design_constraints and ai_constraints.

value.description: The resolved value (string, array, boolean, or number depending on the constraint). Never null — omit the key instead of writing null.

chosen_by.description: How the value was resolved: user (answered/corrected), default (documented default or 'I don't know'), extracted (inferred from inventory/billing/code), derived (computed from answers + detected capabilities).

source.description: Provenance signal. REQUIRED (in prose, not enforced here) when chosen_by is 'extracted' (prefix terraform:/billing:/code:/inventory:/ai-profile:) or 'default' (default:<Qid>). Omitted for 'user' and 'derived'.

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp the final preferences were written.

questions_defaulted.description: Question IDs resolved by documented default (sheet-confirmed or skipped).

questions_skipped_extracted.description: Question IDs resolved because inventory already provided the answer.

questions_skipped_early_exit.description: Question IDs skipped by early-exit logic.

questions_skipped_not_applicable.description: Question IDs skipped because the service wasn't present or the firing condition wasn't met.

clarify_mode.description: Which clarify flow produced this artifact.

design_constraints.description: Zero-or-more infrastructure constraints, each a constraintEntry. Absent key = no constraint (Design decides). No null values.

ai_constraints.description: CONDITIONAL — present ONLY if Category F fired (AI artifacts exist). Zero-or-more AI constraints, each a constraintEntry.
